title: Directs the Oregon Criminal Justice Commission to study recidivism rates of persons granted a pardon and to provide the results of the study to the appropriate interim committees of the Legislative Assembly no later than December 31, 2026.

claims.text: SB 255 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
